regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I write your Brother Fred yester- day and now I come to your favor of Febr. 12. Many Thanks I've just noted your request for the Poor Holy Souls .... and hope that things brighten up soon. Tell George I send him one of my good ear pulls. Tell him "life" that the world is so inclined to worship is too short to act discouraged about anything in it. Ha Hal
